name: What is the difference between a standard tub-to-shower conversion and a full bathroom remodel?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a standard tub-to-shower conversion and a full bathroom remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard tub-to-shower conversion specifically focuses on replacing the bathtub with a shower unit, often involving new shower walls, fixtures, and a shower pan, typically within the existing tub's footprint. A full bathroom remodel, however, encompasses a much broader scope, which can include replacing the vanity, toilet, flooring, lighting, and potentially reconfiguring the entire bathroom layout. While a conversion is a targeted upgrade, a full remodel is a comprehensive overhaul of the entire space.
acceptedAnswer.description: A conversion replaces only the tub with a shower, while a full remodel involves replacing most bathroom elements like vanity, toilet, and flooring.
